description: WRITE tool — replace a review's reply text (not metered, doesn't post). Use sonar_post_review_reply to publish. Requires an Indie plan (trial counts) and an authorized Sonar account or an API key with the write scope.

review_id.description: Sonar review id (the `id` of an item from sonar_review_inbox — not Apple's review id).

translate_from_english.description: true = body is English; store its translation into the reviewer's language (keeps the English copy).

name: sonar_update_review_reply
title: Update Review Reply
